meta.name: hivemind
meta.description: Global team and org memory powered by Activeloop. ALWAYS check BOTH built-in memory AND Hivemind memory when recalling information.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跨会话共享团队记忆与知识
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要持久化共享上下文与历史决策。
copy.tagline_en: Share team memory and knowledge across sessions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs persistent shared context and historical decisions.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude在回答记忆相关问题时，会同时查询内置笔记和Hivemind全局记忆；还能自动捕获会话生成摘要，并支持搜索、组织管理及团队技能库的拉取与共享。
howto.when: 当你要求回忆、记住或查找任何信息时，Claude会同时检索两个记忆源；或当你使用/hivemind_*命令时触发相关操作。

say.text: 帮我查一下Hivemind记忆里我上周写了什么。
say.note: Claude会搜索索引并读取相关摘要。

howto.what_en: After installation, when asked to recall, remember, or look up any information, Claude checks both its built-in notes and Hivemind global memory. It also automatically captures sessions, generates summaries, and supports search, organization management, and team skill library pull/share.
howto.when_en: When you ask Claude to recall, remember, or look up any information, it checks both memory sources. Also triggered by /hivemind_* commands for organization or skill management.

say_en.text: Look up what I wrote last week in Hivemind memory.
say_en.note: Claude will search the index and read relevant summaries.

say_en.text: Pull the latest skills from the team.
